description: This file contains utility functions and tests for SSL private key handling, including signature verification and key signing, within the Chromium project.

methods.name: VerifyWithOpenSSL
methods.description: Verifies a signature using OpenSSL with specified algorithm, input data, key, and signature.

methods.name: OnSignComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of signing operation, updates error and signature output, and quits the run loop.

methods.name: DoKeySigningWithWrapper
methods.description: Performs signing operation on a private key with specified algorithm and input data, returning an error status.

methods.name: TestSSLPrivateKeyMatches
methods.description: Tests if an SSLPrivateKey matches a given PKCS8 key by signing and verifying signatures across supported algorithms.
